facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; you can even keep export earnings abroad without converting them.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Abroad, yes; local foreign-currency accounts for individuals aren't confirmed.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Mercado Pago opens a business account with just your CPF, no company needed.
facts.L1_registration: Not required: work as an autônomo, or open an MEI if your job qualifies.
facts.L2_tax_id: CPF, the taxpayer number from Receita Federal.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Pay carnê-leão monthly on foreign income; up to R$5,000 a month is effectively tax-free.
facts.L4_vat_gst: No VAT yet; exported services pay no ISS if the result happens abroad.
facts.L5_data_protection: LGPD, supervised by the ANPD; fines up to R$50 million per violation.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel online purchases within 7 days; show your CPF or CNPJ online.
facts.L7_incentives: Keep earnings abroad, no ISS on exports, and zero tax up to R$5,000 monthly.
facts.D1_id_document: National ID card (CIN), which uses your CPF number.

watch_out.text: Services whose result happens in Brazil are taxed, even if paid from abroad.
MEI only covers listed jobs; many professional occupations are reportedly excluded.
Declare foreign assets over US$1 million to the Central Bank (CBE).
